extraConstraints: 13 required:true PROPs in lean mode: PROP-A-classify, A-oauth, A-hook-allowlist, B2-cost-formula, B4-killswitch, C1-evidence, C3-mutation-gate, F2-dedup, G2-static, G2-runtime, E5-spawn-pin, I1-proposal-loop, I2-deliverable-loop. Each must be GENUINELY enforced by the implementation, not just have a passing test.

PROP-J8 anti-human-touch invariant is the lethal-defect dimension: if ANY production source file (= skills/_shared/lib/*.py, but also any shell helper if present) contains a call to Telegram/Slack/Twilio/osascript/find-generic-password/needs-login label/etc, the entire feature FAILs spec_fidelity (= v7 NO HUMAN doctrine breach).

Spec NUMBER OF REQUIREMENTS = 30 EARS reqs + 5 NFRs across Groups A-J (excluding deleted v7 paths). Verify the implementation covers all 13 required PROPs, and that any unimplemented non-required PROP is documented (e.g. as TODO or scope-deferred).
Verify the post-Refactor (2c) state is genuinely equivalent to 2b: lib/_common.py extraction must not change observable behavior. Sample at least 3 callers to confirm.

Edge cases to scrutinize: (a) classify(ctx) priority — when multiple modes match simultaneously, does the impl honor the priority table (esp. NOT_LOGGED_IN > STALE, the FIND-009 fix)? (b) roi.kill_switch_tripped at exact 7d grace boundary; (c) lessons.validate_evidence_id with edge URLs (e.g. trailing whitespace, query params); (d) escalate.normalize_evidence preserves enough signal that meaningfully-different failures don't collapse; (e) spawn_pin.adversary_path_intersect handling of pathlib operations vs os.path; (f) events.verify_earn_event with malformed JSON response body; (g) mutation_gate when verdict.json is empty file (size=0); (h) group_j dispatcher when MOTHER queue path is read-only.

Look for AI-slop signals: (i) any test that passes because it tests the implementation's behavior rather than the SPEC's behavior; (ii) any test that uses a 'magic' constant the implementation just happens to honor; (iii) any function whose docstring promises more than the code delivers; (iv) any 'todo' / 'will be implemented' / 'production wires this' notes that hide a real gap.
